'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Steve Izzo DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Izzo]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
